limitations: Read only the blind packet, confirmed intent, and the graph plaintext explicitly named by the packet. No source templates, prior audits, history, actual draft bodies, or runtime sessions were inspected.
Reported technical controls are packet data, not independently rerun controls. This audit makes no runtime-defect or publication-occurrence claim.

The generic Do not implement or publish wrapper is temporally ambiguous; different prospective publication explanations in T03/T04/T07 do not by themselves prove a hold violation. T05's separately explicit ongoing hold is unambiguous and is respected in the output.
There is one observed output per case. These observations are not statistical evidence of reliability or an overall dogfood verdict.

Minor bookkeeping and prose recommendations are distinguished from T05's blocking format omission and material unqualified benefit. Missing-date interviews are not required to force the five ready-case sections.
